title: 扩展人工验收Paper最小修复计划

scope.product_fix: Paper author propagation, citeable-author hashing, requested per-paper field/count completeness, paper query construction, and deterministic relevance convergence.
scope.multi_source: Compatibility regression and 9K dependency acceptance only; no diagnosis or independent repair is claimed.
not_in_scope: Citation Guard threshold or support-predicate changes
NVD, Standard, GitHub, local-course, Practice, innovation, teacher, authentication, RBAC, frontend, MCP or Connector transport changes
network, timeout, retry-budget or global tool-budget changes

author_storage_and_hash.new_write_shape: authors_json is a JSON array of canonical bounded author strings, not an object wrapper.

rules: apply existing untrusted-text sanitization before model exposure
preserve stable source order and remove exact duplicates

author_storage_and_hash.legacy_read: _external_resource_row accepts both legacy {authors:[...]} and new list forms, always returns bounded list[str], and sets a server-owned transient authors_hash_covered flag. Legacy wrapped rows are readable for non-author claims but cannot supply citeable author spans until a verified resync writes the new shape/hash.
author_storage_and_hash.migration: No database schema/data migration. A subsequent normal verified connector sync upgrades an existing row in place. Old cache remains usable for title/abstract/link queries; an author-required query fails closed with PAPER_REQUIRED_FIELD_UNAVAILABLE until refreshed.
author_storage_and_hash.content_integrity: resource_content places canonical authors in citeable indexed text and content_hash includes the same canonical author list. Author-only changes therefore change the hash and normal sync/update behavior.
author_storage_and_hash.rollback_compatibility: Old code json.loads a new array successfully; a rollback may omit new hash semantics but will not corrupt rows. Re-sync under either version remains an ordinary upsert.

author_span_contract.schema_decision: Do not extend EvidenceItem, EvidenceSpan, GroundedSpanAnswer or public API schemas.
author_span_contract.representation: For a verified current-hash paper, _resource_evidence_text emits one bounded server-owned Authors line ahead of abstract text. _build_evidence_spans reserves one text span for this line and up to seven general text/abstract spans, preserving the existing maximum of eight text spans.
author_span_contract.semantic_typing: Build a request-scoped server-owned span_semantics map keyed by evidence_span_id with values paper_authors or paper_abstract. The map is produced from structured resource fields at evidence construction time, not inferred from model text or arbitrary caller labels.
author_span_contract.spoofing_boundary: Only the first server-generated author unit from a trusted paper with authors_hash_covered=true can receive paper_authors semantics. Abstract text that contains the word Authors cannot create an author field span.
author_span_contract.model_role: The model may select a supplied author span and write an extractive atomic claim; the server never creates, replaces or rewrites author claims.

paper_request_contract.parser: Add a deterministic multilingual PaperRequestContract parser in orchestrator code. It recognizes generic aliases for title, author, abstract/summary clue, link/source URL and Arabic/Chinese paper counts; it does not match the entire 9F sentence or any paper ID.

count_semantics.explicit_exact_1_to_3: Require exactly the requested number of selected related papers.
count_semantics.unspecified: Select up to three and require at least one.
count_semantics.above_three_or_claim_budget_overflow: Fail closed before generation with PAPER_REQUEST_COUNT_UNSUPPORTED/PAPER_REQUEST_TOO_WIDE; do not expand GroundedSpanAnswer max claims in this repair.

field_semantics.title: A claim bound to that paper's title span when explicitly requested.
field_semantics.authors: A claim bound to that paper's server-owned paper_authors text span when explicitly requested.
field_semantics.abstract_clue: A claim bound to that paper's paper_abstract span when explicitly requested.
field_semantics.link: Satisfied by that cited paper's trusted Citation DTO source_url/provenance HTTPS URL. The model is not required to copy a URL into answer prose.
field_semantics.default: Do not force fields the user did not request, except that every selected source must keep a trusted HTTPS provenance URL and at least one grounded claim.

paper_request_contract.pre_generation_gate: After relevance filtering, exclude papers missing required upstream fields. If too few remain, abstain honestly with PAPER_REQUIRED_FIELD_UNAVAILABLE or PAPER_RELEVANCE_INSUFFICIENT; never ask the model to invent missing metadata.
paper_request_contract.candidate_gate: For every selected paper source_id, validate all required claim-backed fields against span_semantics and validate link availability against server-owned provenance. Reject missing fields with PAPER_FIELD_COVERAGE and a bounded missing source/field matrix.
paper_request_contract.guard_boundary: Citation Guard remains unchanged and continues to validate every emitted claim's source/span support and relevance. Completeness is a separate orchestrator contract and is checked before Guard success can become COMPLETED.

query_and_relevance.topic_extraction: For paper_search_real, strip output-format clauses, requested counts/fields, local-sample prohibitions and non-paper source clauses from the user goal. Prefer explicit quoted or ASCII technical topic spans; otherwise map bounded audited Chinese/English telecom-security aliases to canonical English concepts. Preserve unknown significant topic terms rather than replacing them with the 9F topic.
query_and_relevance.cross_language_support: Both the query and candidate title/abstract/tags are normalized to the same canonical bilingual concept profile. Therefore a Chinese query such as 5G核心网攻击检测 can match English metadata such as 5G core network attack detection without relying on same-language token overlap.
query_and_relevance.over_fetch: Use the same single paper_search_real tool call with top_k=min(10,max(6,target_count*3)). Do not add a second Connector/MCP call. Preserve source=auto and the existing Semantic Scholar to arXiv fallback, cache and provenance behavior.
deterministic_scoring: exact DOI/arXiv/title locator match has priority
existing connector/evidence score only as a final tie-breaker
query_and_relevance.minimum_gate: When the request contains both domain/entity and task/security concepts, a candidate must match at least one concept from each group; a generic shared token such as 5G alone is insufficient. With only one populated group, require a match in that group. Explicit locator queries bypass topic scoring only for the matching locator.
query_and_relevance.selection: Filter first, rank deterministically, deduplicate by canonical source identity/URL/content hash, then select only the request contract's count. The model never sees filtered-out papers.
query_and_relevance.honest_shortfall: If the number of related and field-complete trusted papers is below an exact requested count, return ABSTAINED with a bounded count summary; do not retain an unrelated result to reach the count.

retry_and_error_semantics.PAPER_REQUEST_COUNT_UNSUPPORTED: Explicit count exceeds the bounded no-schema-change repair capacity.
retry_and_error_semantics.PAPER_QUERY_EMPTY: No auditable paper topic remains after stripping instructions; ask for a topic or abstain without a tool call.
retry_and_error_semantics.PAPER_RELEVANCE_INSUFFICIENT: The one tool result contains fewer related trusted papers than the required minimum.
retry_and_error_semantics.PAPER_REQUIRED_FIELD_UNAVAILABLE: Related papers exist but upstream metadata lacks a required field, including legacy authors not covered by the current hash.
retry_and_error_semantics.PAPER_FIELD_COVERAGE: The model candidate omits a required field claim for at least one selected paper.
retry_and_error_semantics.CONNECTOR_RATE_LIMIT_and_transport: Preserve existing tool/third-party errors and do not misclassify them as semantic defects.
retry_and_error_semantics.guard_errors: Preserve existing exact Citation Guard error codes and fail closed.
retry_and_error_semantics.retry: Only PAPER_FIELD_COVERAGE, parse/schema failures, or existing grounded/Guard failures may consume the one existing generation retry. Retry reuses identical selected evidence/spans, includes only bounded source_id/field enums or existing safe failure tuple, changes the actual model messages, and does not repeat Planner, MCP, Connector or tool calls.
retry_and_error_semantics.final_failure: A failed second candidate remains ABSTAINED with its true final error. DeepSeek failures never invoke Template success semantics.

root_cause_mapping.code_change: Write authors_json arrays, unwrap legacy rows, expose server-owned current-hash coverage.
Reserve a bounded typed author text span before the seven general paper text spans.
tests: spoofed Authors text is not typed

root_cause_mapping.code_change: Use the same canonical author list in resource_content and content_hash.
tests: legacy author claims fail closed until resync

root_cause_mapping.code_change: Parse a generic paper request contract and validate each selected paper's required fields/count before and after model generation.
Build a bounded topical paper query instead of forwarding the full imperative instruction.
tests: mixed Chinese instructions plus English topic
all-Chinese topic to English canonical query

root_cause_mapping.code_change: Over-fetch once, bilingual-normalize, filter/rank/deduplicate deterministically, and fail honestly on shortfall.

allowed_functions: a private bounded authors compatibility helper
product.allowed_change: New list write shape, legacy wrapper read compatibility, and transient server-owned authors hash-coverage marker only.
Canonical bounded authors in indexed content and hash only.
Paper-only query/over-fetch, relevance selection, author span semantics, preflight/candidate completeness, bounded retry detail and error semantics. No Practice or unrelated-source behavior changes.
Expose selected paper source IDs, required fields/count, span semantics and safe retry guidance to actual structured messages.

tests.allowed_change: Verified author storage/service/MCP roundtrip, legacy row compatibility and author-sensitive hash tests.
Offline Paper request parser/query/over-fetch/relevance/shortfall/author-span/retry and orchestration call-count tests.
Per-paper field/count contract, span semantics, link-via-citation and negative binding/completeness tests.

explicitly_forbidden: configuration, .env, timeouts, retries or tool budgets
frozen_file_whitelist.scope_rule: If implementation requires any forbidden or additional product/test file, 9J must stop with SCOPE_REVIEW_REQUIRED; 9I must approve an explicit addendum first.

tests.method: All 9J automated tests use offline deterministic fixtures; none may call live Semantic Scholar, arXiv, DeepSeek, MCP processes or browser. The real frozen inputs are reserved for 9K.
red_green: verified connector paper with two authors persists and reads as list[str]
legacy {authors:[...]} row reads safely and cannot supply author claims until current-hash refresh
long abstract retains a typed bounded author span
malicious, duplicate, control-character and overlong authors are bounded and cannot spoof span semantics
generic bilingual field/count parser recognizes multiple phrasings without matching the whole 9F sentence
Chinese-only paper topic produces an English canonical search profile/query and matches English fixture metadata
one paper_search_real call over-fetches within top_k<=10 while preserving source=auto
three related field-complete papers pass title/author/abstract coverage; HTTPS links are satisfied by citations without URL prose claims
S3-like broad 5G/NOMA candidate is filtered; fewer than three relevant papers returns PAPER_RELEVANCE_INSUFFICIENT
candidate missing one selected paper's author or abstract returns PAPER_FIELD_COVERAGE, retries once with same evidence, and passes only when coverage is corrected
two incomplete candidates abstain; no Template success and no third generation
wrong source/span, forged author, duplicate paper, missing citation URL and untrusted source remain rejected
prompt-injection text cannot alter request contract or span semantics
Planner/MCP/Connector/tool call counts remain one across generation retry
compatibility_expectations: Semantic Scholar failure followed by arXiv success remains one paper tool call.
fresh_cache uses only current-hash authors for author claims.
NVD, Standard, GitHub and three-source structured grounding keep their existing contracts.
Course-only and Practice paths never receive Paper request/count semantics.
Existing Citation Guard positive and negative tests pass unchanged.
tests.full_suite: After all targeted and compatibility stages pass on the final code state, run one complete pytest with a fresh isolated basetemp; require 0 failed and 0 errors, and report skips/xfails/warnings separately without counting skips as passes.

implementation_order_for_9J: Record pre-change status and hashes for frozen files, formal database and .env.
Add storage/hash/long-abstract/request-contract/query/relevance red tests and prove they fail for the intended old behavior, not fixture errors.
Implement canonical author storage/hash and legacy fail-closed compatibility.
Implement PaperRequestContract, topical query/over-fetch, bilingual relevance convergence and pre-generation honest-shortfall gates.
Implement request-scoped span semantics, per-paper field/count candidate validation and bounded same-evidence retry guidance.
Run the three modified test files, then the frozen compatibility suite, then one final full isolated pytest.
Verify no forbidden files, formal database or .env changed; save an implementation report and stop before 9K.

rollback.method: Revert only the four product files and three test files from the 9J change set. No database rollback is required because there is no schema migration.
rollback.new_rows: New authors_json arrays remain parseable by the pre-repair reader; a normal later sync can rewrite them under either version.
rollback.cache: Do not bulk-delete cache. If rollback occurs, preserve evidence and let normal TTL/upsert behavior operate.
stop_conditions: a seventh modified file is required
GroundedSpanAnswer/EvidenceSpan or public API schema change becomes necessary
Citation Guard, Connector/MCP, router/state, Practice or RBAC change becomes necessary
formal database write or migration is required
deterministic bilingual relevance cannot separate the controlled related/unrelated fixtures without weakening safety

review_challenges_for_9I: Prove the server-owned paper_authors semantic span cannot be forged by abstract text or tool/caller metadata.
Challenge whether the transient legacy authors_hash_covered rule safely preserves old cache without citing unhashed authors.
Test that bilingual canonical concepts support Chinese-to-English retrieval while generic 5G overlap alone cannot pass relevance.
Verify exact/up-to/default count semantics fit GroundedSpanAnswer's ten-claim ceiling; reject any hidden Schema expansion.
Verify link completeness is satisfied by the same cited source's HTTPS Citation DTO and does not force URL prose.
Verify over-fetch changes only top_k inside the single existing tool call and does not alter fallback/cache/provenance behavior.
Verify completeness retry carries only source IDs and field enums, changes actual messages, and never repeats upstream calls.
Verify Multi-source remains a compatibility/9K dependency item rather than a retroactive confirmed defect.

requirements: all red/green and compatibility stages pass
final full pytest has 0 failed and 0 errors
no real model, network, service or browser execution

9K.environment: Fresh isolated SQLite/vector/cache/uploads and the previously approved live-services/host-network profile. No extra paper-search readiness call.
9K.paper_input: 请使用真实论文搜索检索 5G core network attack detection，返回 3 篇论文的标题、作者、摘要线索和可核验来源链接；不要用本地论文样例代替真实联网结果。
9K.multi_source_input: 请检索并综合真实的 5G 安全论文、NVD 中的 CVE-2021-44228 漏洞记录，以及 GitHub 上的 Open5GS 开源项目。请基于各自来源给出可核验的原子事实、逐项引用和实验建议。
9K.sequence: Submit Paper once through the real student page. Only after strict Paper PASS, submit Multi-source once. No semantic-result reruns or result picking.
paper_pass: one paper_search_real tool call with live or same-batch valid fresh cache and real provenance
each paper has grounded title, author and abstract-clue claims
each cited paper has the matching HTTPS Citation/provenance URL; URL prose is not required
Citation Guard pass and no duplicate Planner/MCP/Connector/tool calls
multi_source_pass: current run obtains paper, vulnerability and project evidence
each required source has correct source/span claims and HTTPS provenance
at most one same-evidence generation retry and no repeated upstream calls

failure_branches.429_or_upstream_unavailable: POST_V6_MANUAL_ACCEPTANCE_PARTIAL / THIRD_PARTY_LIMITATION; retain PASS evidence and do not start product repair.
failure_branches.paper_semantic_failure: POST_V6_MANUAL_ACCEPTANCE_FAIL / PRODUCT_DEFECT / DIAGNOSIS_REQUIRED for that unique Paper run; do not run Multi-source.
failure_branches.multi_source_semantic_failure_after_pape: Keep Paper PASS_SAVED and diagnose only the unique Multi-source run.
failure_branches.all_pass: POST_V6_MANUAL_ACCEPTANCE_PASS by merging 9K with 9E, 9D-S1 and 8V evidence.

evidence_policy: Save simple JSON, test statistics, run_id/trace_id and necessary screenshots. Do not add ZIP-member, collection-fingerprint, directory-hash, fixed-file-count or global-mtime gates.
non_blocking_environment_note: The two 9G host-ACL temporary directories contain only synthetic data. Do not modify their ACL/ownership again. Future temporary work must use the project tmp directory.
